in_sanskrit.name: चिरयु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chirayu is derived from the Sanskrit word चिर (chira) which means 'everlasting, enduring, immortal'. The suffix 'ayu' (आयु) means 'life' or 'age'. Thus, Chirayu can be translated as 'one who has an everlasting or immortal life'.

in_hindi.name: चिरायु
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chirayu is a Sanskrit name which is derived from the words चिर (chira) and आयु (ayu). Chira means 'everlasting, enduring, immortal' and ayu means 'life' or 'age'. Thus, Chirayu can be translated as 'one who has an everlasting or immortal life'.

in_tamil.name: சிறையு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chirayu in Tamil is derived from the words சிறை (ciṟai) and யு (yu). Ciṟai means 'everlasting, enduring, immortal' and yu means 'life' or 'age'. Thus, Chirayu can be translated as 'one who has an everlasting or immortal life'.

in_telugu.name: చిరయు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chirayu in Telugu is derived from the words చిర (chira) and యు (yu). Chira means 'everlasting, enduring, immortal' and yu means 'life' or 'age'. Thus, Chirayu can be translated as 'one who has an everlasting or immortal life'.

in_marathi.name: Chirayu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Young, Brave God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chirayu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chirayu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chira' meaning young and 'Ayu' meaning life or god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Vishnu, who is often referred to as 'Chirayu' in certain scriptures. This name signifies the young and brave form of the god.
